correctness.rationale: Orthogonality of all even modulations on length N=2p gives S(i,j)=p 1_{i congruent j mod p} sum_{k=0,1}g_{i-k}conj(g_{j-k}), yielding p Hermitian 2x2 blocks W_j=[a_j,b_j][a_j,b_j]^* with independent a_j ~CN(0,I/2), b_j=a_{j-1} except b_0=U a_{p-1}. Independently constructed full Gabor matrix and p blocks for p=3,5,7, with maximum entry differences <3e-15. Square two-by-two complex Wishart has exact single-block survival P(L>x)=e^{-4x}, and distinct nonadjacent blocks are independent. Adjacent rare-event joint bound follows from determinant s|w|^2 and trace, yielding P(L_j<=eps,L_{j+1}<=eps)=O(eps^2(1+|log eps|)) after integrating Gamma(shape 2,rate 2) shared squared norm. Dependency-graph Chen–Stein hence TV(Pois(4t)) error O_t(log p/p) for fixed t; no-rare-event probability gives P(pA_p>t)->e^{-4t}. Independent nonadjacent matching gives uniform e^{-4u/3} tail majorant for p>=3, justifying all positive moments Gamma(r+1)/4^r. These arguments address all p>=3, include cyclic seam and distinguish minimum squared frame eigenvalue from singular value; numeric checks support only finite algebra.
